text:
nina: spotted an oddity in the Cost Overview card—cache savings are attributed to model_sku only, routes missing. happened after yesterday's ingest change.

ricardo: can you share the query or sample events? sounds like a normalization issue where billing_context.route_id isn't preserved.

nina: pasted quick query we used:
```
SELECT model_sku, route_id, SUM(cache_saved_tokens) AS saved
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY model_sku, route_id
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
raw rows show route_id=\"checkout-v2\" with 200k saved but card shows model_sku=\"small-prod\" 200k and no route breakdown.

ben: last refactor collapsed billing_key to a scalar to reduce cardinality. we ended up folding route into metadata but aggregator still groups by billing_key only.

nina: UX ask: can the UI show both "Observed (raw)" and "Attributed (per-route)" columns? that would make rollouts less noisy.

ricardo: backend plan: change normalizer to emit explicit route_id and model_sku columns into token_ledger. prefer route for attribution when present. also add top-N bucketing server-side (top-5) to avoid high-cardinality explosion.

ben: we'll gate via feature flag `costs.per_route_view` default off. rollout: dev -> staging -> prod 10% -> full. add backfill for last 3 days into new column so historical toggles work.

ui-bot: note: UI will render top-5 routes + "other" row and a micro-latency hint when flag enabled.

nina: tests: unit test for two events same model_sku diff routes splitting savings, e2e for UI toggle. also alert if attribution delta >25% for any tenant during rollout.

ricardo: I'll open a draft PR with normalizer change + migration + feature flag. will link screenshots for the UI once ben posts mocks.

ben: will mock screenshots and add the latency/other UX copy. also will add aggregator cap to 5 routes and ensure deterministic tie-breakers.

nina: thanks. PR link when ready please and ping me for the staging canary.
